events.finding: Grouped multi-key cross-reference calls were initially parsed as one target.
events.resolution: Parse and bind every comma-separated key within the source call.

events.finding: A slash remained in continuous listener prose.
events.resolution: Expand the bounded prose slash forms and forbid residual slash tokens.

events.finding: Source-span diagrams overlapped ordinary prose replay.
events.resolution: Replace each exact TikZ source span once before prose projection and bind its stable diagram ID.

events.finding: A comment seam displaced a correction disclosure from its source paragraph.
events.resolution: Anchor disclosures after the exact source paragraph containing the correction coordinate.

events.finding: Three bare-s suffixes were absent from the apostrophe-s-only inflection census.
events.resolution: Classify bare-s and apostrophe-s forms separately, then prove plural and possessive closure.

events.finding: Source punctuation adjacent to binding sentinels could detach or duplicate in speech.
events.resolution: Project every punctuation coordinate through a sentinel ledger, normalize standalone tokens, and require an explicit structural owner for every silent coordinate.
